bio: Sharing is the focus of this appealing restaurant. Good-quality ingredients go into imaginative dishes that you can combine as you see fit to create your own set menu. Some tables afford a view into the glass-fronted kitchen. The staff are friendly and professional, and you can confidently follow the wine recommendations. Chambino bar and bistro is located diagonally opposite. Gorgeous lively terrace overlooking the Alte Brücke (Old Bridge)....
